reviews.text: A fun word game, the cauldreon mechanic is engaging and push your english vocabulary to find the best word with the tools you have! Really recommend!

Get this if you like word games, Scratches a similar itch to wordle or crossword puzzles but in a unique way. Highly replayable with several different modes and lots of items you can collect and buy during a run. No two runs are the same. Gonna play every morning to warm up my brain

When I first read "word game" and "roguelike" in the same sentence, I didn't think it would work. But I was proven wrong pretty much immediately when I tried the demo for the first time. This game is super cozy, EXTREMELY polished, and horribly addicting. I only stopped playing so I could write this review. The Balatro comparisons will surely come, but I think this game is unique/strong enough to stand on its own. I won't say much about it since I made it, but I think the music turned out pretty good 🤓

It's good fun! Sort of like balatro with spelling. It's harder than Balatro because you've got to spell long words with a jumble of letters, so it's a bit more "puzzle"-like - but it has all the fun gameplay loops like scrolls, one time use items, modifiers, etc so you can get big combos. Decent!
Pretty fun game. Definitely scratches the same itch in my brain that Wordle does.

Such a smart simple idea to mix a word game with the Suika formula, surprised it didn't come along sooner. Great casual pick up and play that works well on controller so great on the Steam Deck if you're lucky enough to have one.

Suika meets Scrabble mixed with roguelike elements, fun to play with an audience of people to yell out solutions. The mix of potions an runes allow even a dummy like me the ability to "be smart" without being smart with words. You can literally build strategy around not being good at spelling or thinking of larger words. A big enough idea of a game where I kept thinking about what else I'd love to see (specifically stashing words to see which I think of has a hire score, or allowing autoplay with something like Twitch chat) Not sure if there's a mobile release but this would be great on the phone as well!
Wonderful game! It's like a mixture of Balatro & Scrabble. The graphics are really cute and the game feel is relaxing.

If you're a fan of word games, Lexispell is an easy recommendation. It combines spelling and vocabulary with roguelite progression in a way that feels both relaxing and rewarding. Looking forward to more dictionaries.
It's addictive. Lexispell is an excellent word game, very well-crafted and a real pleasure to play. When I have 10 minutes free, I open this game and I play it.
Words! More Words! Over 26 different letters!!! BUILD YOUR OWN WORDS!!!! No, for real, I love the game. It's very fun. Have a good time, playing it.
it's too simple to be engaging, and it's full of bugs (letters disappearing from bag when you save, cursor disappearing, etc.). Sorry, but it's not engaging.

This is a great word game with a nice Suika twist, it is both challenging and very rewarding as you progress through it. The addition of scrolls, runes, and enchantments gives you lots to come back for, using different combinations to really boost your score and climb those leader boards. A highly polished, fun and challenging word game!

i have admittedly not played much of this game, but the formula is great. similar to Word Play, but with a lot more potential for longer, more satisfying words. the 'drop' system is a good take on the requisite reroll mechanic, and there is a lot of potential with the items and runes. definitely a must grab if you like word games!!
I liked the part with the letters
Great word game. Scrabble x Balatro

Surprisingly fun considering its relatively simple concept. Would recommend if you love puzzle games and looking for something quick and fun with replayability all the while taking up minimal storage.
Just 90 minutes in and I am hooked. Love the aesthetic and clean buttons. Only thing i could recommend is some more music variety.
I like the game mechanics, the humor, and the presentation. Other word games with similar mechanics don't hit like this one does. Great job, devs!

It's pretty enjoyable, and I love the art and vibe, but... there's not too much here? It's a pretty tiny game - and unless you play the timed mode, there's not that much else to explore, and different characters don't change that much in terms of variety. That said - for word games enjoyers, it's a pretty nice time.

One of those games where you either play a quick round for 10 mins in between doing things, or spending a few hours being entranced while struggling to spell basic words. Very fun, and I think if the dev can optimize the game well enough to run on mobile devices, it would do even better there. I can see myself playing this on my lunch breaks to pass the time and brush up on my vocabulary. Literally cannot complain about a single thing considering the replay value you get out of it for the price. Had fun with the demo, glad I bought the full game.
Made with Godot
An incredibly juicy, physics roguelike word game. Gather handy spells and charms to boost that score even higher.
Nothing specific for this game so labeling as informational. Link attached has more info + is a direct conversation with the dev.
Lexispell is a cozy, physics-based roguelike word game that combines tactical spelling with powerful upgrades, challenging players to merge letters and craft massive words to restore order.
Fun Game! Has chill-mode and time-rush, both fun to play.

Scrabble, Suika, and a Roguelike had a baby called Lexispell. Keeps it simple for an approachable intro to the genre. Main game has boss and items variety for replayability. Speed mode is frantic fun!
